title: Early Christian libraries discovered in the 1940s

tellings.quote: in the 1940s we found a lot of libraries of the early Christians and we got an insight into what you know influenced them well the allegory of the cave and Plato's Republic influenced them

plain: In the 1940s, libraries belonging to early Christians were found, and they showed what had shaped those believers' thinking: Plato's Republic and his allegory of the cave. That is how a scholar of religion named Diana Pasulka puts it to Michels, summarising without naming a source. If she is right, Greek philosophy sat near the roots of early Christian ideas about hidden realities.
